task.title: Consolidate CodeWiki public and agent tool surface
task.summary: Introduce a smaller CodeWiki public and agent workflow tool surface by removing deprecated aliases and static catalogs instead of preserving compatibility shims.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki exposes a smaller direct tool surface, with deprecated aliases and dead application catalogs removed; callers use replacement tools directly and tests/docs enforce the new surface.
acceptance: `codewiki_claim` is not registered and callers use `codewiki_artifact_status` directly.
Static application tool catalog source is removed; the skill-facing catalog remains the documented tool map.
Deleted alias/catalog files are absent from package smoke and active docs.
Artifact-status coordination tests cover mark/read-overlap/conflict/release without the claim alias.
Active system docs and roadmap no longer instruct preserving wrapper aliases as the migration policy.
non_goals: Do not remove real application use-case services that still orchestrate IO, mutation, rebuild, or validation.
Do not refactor `src/application/claims.ts` into domain in this slice; keep runtime coordination behavior stable while removing the public alias.
Do not change handoff/worktree-isolation behavior owned by TASK-006 beyond avoiding stale references.

closure_brief.user_intent: Remove deprecated/stale application tool shims and docs instead of preserving compatibility wrappers; fix breakage by using direct replacement surfaces.
implemented_changes: Removed codewiki_claim registration, schema, adapter file, and application tool file.
Removed dead static src/application/tools/catalog.ts and updated tests/docs to rely on skill-facing catalog only.
Updated artifact-status messages/tests to use codewiki_artifact_status conflict terminology.
Updated README, skill catalog, and system docs to remove compatibility-alias preservation policy.
acceptance_evidence: npm run test:smoke passed after replacing claim alias smoke coverage with artifact-status coverage.
npm run check:architecture passed with 76 TypeScript source files after deleting three stale files.
non_goals_preserved: Did not remove real application orchestration services still needed for IO/rebuild/validation.
Did not refactor src/application/claims.ts into domain in this slice.
Did not change TASK-006 handoff/worktree-isolation behavior.
remaining_risks: External users of codewiki_claim must migrate to codewiki_artifact_status.

risks: Downstream callers still using codewiki_claim will fail and must migrate to codewiki_artifact_status per user rule.
